requirements.title: Extensions inherit parent entities with their original attributes
requirements.definition: An extended type acquires all parent type parameters and components and the nonoverridden type-bound procedures, retaining their attributes. Inaccessible components/bindings are inherited without becoming accessible in unrelated scopes. Additional parameters, components and bindings are permitted but not required. Inherited procedure-pointer components remain components; FINAL bindings have their own noninheritance/finalization rules and are not silently treated as methods.

Type extension is not module descent. Parameter order, component order, initialization and finalization are not duplicate local oracles.

requirements.title: The implicit parent component is scalar, nonpointer and nonallocatable with parent parameters
requirements.source: 7.5.7.2 p2, first sentence; PDF104, printed90, lines15-16.
requirements.definition: Every extended type has a scalar, nonpointer, nonallocatable parent component of the parent's type and type parameters. This component is not an independently allocated object or a pointer to a separately copied parent. Its scalar nature does not make an array parent's component selection scalar: data-ref rank still depends on the full selector. Initial whole-parent observations use nonabstract parents.

pending.nonpointer-canonical-pair-plan: PENDING — Source-use at C1026: prospective canonical negative assigns child%parent => target, with a live scalar TYPE(parent), TARGET target and an explicit pointer component link of matching type. Repair only the LHS selector to child%link. Require the implicit parent component's absence of POINTER, not a bad target, rank or type. Both are compile-only plans; never query ASSOCIATED on the nonpointer parent.
pending.nonallocatable-canonical-pair-plan: PENDING — Source-use at C936: prospective canonical negative ALLOCATE(child%parent), with an explicit scalar allocatable component heap of the same ordinary nonparameterized parent type. Repair only the selector to child%heap. Cause is the implicit parent's lack of POINTER/ALLOCATABLE, not allocation failure. No allocation is executed here and no ALLOCATED(nonallocatable-parent) false oracle is allowed.
pending.abstract-whole-parent-source-use: PENDING — Source-use at C911: an abstract parent component exists implicitly, but a rightmost abstract data-ref must be polymorphic. No TYPE(abstract) dummy, whole abstract parent call or inquiry is a conforming control. A future canonical whole-component negative can be repaired by selecting an accessible defined nonabstract subcomponent instead, with the actual C911 abstract-rightmost cause.

requirements.oracle: Three runtime cases observe a scalar parent component through RANK=0 and an explicit TYPE(parent) helper yielding17; keyword-instantiated abstract parameters k=2,n=3,m=5 through the actual parent selector; and rank1 for an array parent designator versus rank0 for one element's parent. A nonpointer dummy can associate with a pointer's target, so that call alone would not prove nonpointer status. Abstract whole-parent references have the independent C911 barrier even though inheritance itself is legal.

requirements.title: The parent component takes its parent name and original defining-module accessibility
requirements.source: 7.5.7.2 p2, second/third sentences; PDF104, printed90, lines16-18.
requirements.definition: The parent component's name is the parent type name used for the extension, which can be a local USE rename. If the extended type is defined in a module, the parent component has the accessibility that the parent type has in the module where that parent type was defined. This is not the child's component default, an importing module's changed accessibility for the local type alias, or the parent components' individual accessibility.

requirements.title: Parent-component views are inheritance associated and ancestor components recurse
requirements.source: 7.5.7.2 p2, final sentences; PDF104, printed90, lines18-20.
requirements.definition: Components of the parent component are inheritance associated with their corresponding inherited components. An ancestor component is either the immediate parent component or an ancestor component of that parent component. The recursive ancestor-component relation is not reflexive in the way extension of types is: the whole child is not its own parent component. Association does not imply independently copied fields or an observable processor storage layout.

requirements.title: A same-spec inherited generic is extended, subject to canonical generic restrictions
requirements.definition: A local generic binding with the same generic-spec as an inherited binding extends that generic interface and satisfies 15.4.3.4.5. Its added members do not replace the whole inherited generic. A specific member may separately be overridden; that is not generic overriding or permission to re-add an inherited member. Generic selection uses the declared type's interface, then the corresponding specific binding in the dynamic type is invoked.
